requirements.label: Choose 3 credits from the following courses:
requirements.text: Choose 3 credits from the following courses:

INFO 1200.title: Computer Programming I for IS IT
INFO 1200.prereqText: MAT 1010 or MAT 1015 recommended; INFO 1120 recommended

INFO 2200.title: Computer Programming II for IS IT
INFO 2200.prereqText: ( INFO 1200 or CS 1400 with a grade of C- or better within the past seven years) or Departmental Approval

INFO 2500.title: Applied Artificial Intelligence Concepts in Organizations

MATH 1050.title: College Algebra
MATH 1050.prereqText: Within the past two years one of the following: MAT 1010 or MAT 1015 with a grade of C or better or appropriate math placement score.

MATH 1055.title: College Algebra with Preliminaries
MATH 1055.prereqText: Within the past two years one of the following: MAT 1010 or MAT 1015 with a grade of C or better or appropriate math placement score.

MATH 1090.title: College Algebra for Business
MATH 1090.prereqText: Within the past two years one of the following: MAT 1010 or MAT 1015 with a grade of C or better or appropriate math placement score.

MATH 2000.title: Algebraic Reasoning with Modeling
MATH 2000.prereqText: Within the past two years, one of the following: MAT 1010 or MAT 1015 with a grade of C or better or an appropriate math placement score.

MGMT 2340.title: Business Statistics I
MGMT 2340.prereqText: MATH 1050 , MATH 1055 , or MATH 1090 or higher, or appropriate test scores

STAT 1040.title: Introduction to Statistics
STAT 1040.prereqText: One of the following: MAT 1010 or MAT 1015 with a grade of C or better within the past two years; an ACT mathematics score of 23 (assuming the test has been taken within the last two years); appropriate placement by the Accuplacer test score
